messages:
mira: Quick async — need a short status dump on the serving perf sprint. Specifically: kernel regression on p95 in the last canary, continuous-batching throughput tuning, and KV warmup ownership. Can owners drop blockers and ETA by EOD?

alex_r: Kernel regression — I saw the p95 jump after the mutex change. Root cause looks like lock contention in batch flush path. I have a branch with a spinlock fallback, running CI perf harness now. ETA for PR: tomorrow morning.

sam_l: Continuous-batcher: traffic shaping patch is in review (GH #4821). Perf improvements locally ~8% throughput. Waiting on kernel patch to land before we can prod-canary.

tay: KV warmup — we have a mismatch in prefetch keys for long-tail sequences. I can take ownership of aligning the prefetch heuristic. Plan: adjust sampling window + add a simple warmup TTL. ETA end of week.

mira: thanks. Can someone add a short list of cross-deps (who must land before canary)? I want an ordered checklist.

alex_r: deps: 1) my kernel lock PR, 2) sam's traffic-shaping, 3) tay's kv-warmup tweak. If any of those stalls, fallback policy should route to variant-v1 (lower batch size).

sam_l: noted. I'll rebase once alex's PR is up. @alex_r please ping when CI perf passes.

jin: ops-bot pushed a canary yesterday with the old kernel; we've collected traces. Attaching quick trace summary snippet: 
```
trace_id: 0x9f3a
stage: batch_flush
avg_latency_ms: 34 -> 82 (after change)
hot_functions: acquire_lock, kv_lookup
```
Use this to correlate.

rachel: small ask: we should update the rollout doc with the fallback route and slowness triggers (SLO breach -> auto-fallback). I can PR if you drop the bullet points here.

mira: bullet points: 
- on p95 >= 2x baseline for 5m -> rollback to variant-v1
- if ops-bot sees KV miss rate spike > 10% for 3m -> disable prefetch sampling
- manual hold if canary error rate > 1% for 10m

alex_r: will add a note in my PR linking to the rollout doc.

sam_l: quick code ping: reviewers for #4821? @tay @rachel would help.

tay: I'll review today.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary started: canary-2024-11-06-17:20. Metrics collection enabled.

mira: thanks all — if you hit a blocker that prevents landing, drop it here and mark urgency. Otherwise, plan is to reconcile tomorrow morning sync.

alex_r: will update thread with CI perf numbers once available.

sam_l: rebase queued, leaving review comment.

rachel: PR for rollout doc coming in ~2 hours.

mira: perfect. Closing loop — meet tomorrow for a short demo if all three PRs land. :thumbsup:
